tagline: European inland waterway industry representative and regulatory liaison body
hero_kpi_rationale: The organization hosted 215 participants at its annual congress in 2024 in Frankfurt, demonstrating its mobilization capacity and central role in the European inland navigation sector. This indicator reflects industry engagement with standardization initiatives, loss prevention, and sustainability.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participation
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants at the annual IVR Congress.
kpis.description: The 2024 annual congress took place from May 15 to 17 in Frankfurt and hosted 215 participants from 11 different European countries, demonstrating the relevance and appeal of the platform for the inland navigation industry.
kpis.signal: Strong member engagement and industry representation

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participation
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium event.
kpis.description: The inaugural IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium on November 4, 2024 in Antwerp attracted approximately 80 participants from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany, establishing this new platform as a potentially recurring event.
kpis.signal: Strong industry engagement with loss prevention initiatives

kpis.name: Countries Represented at Congress
kpis.explanation: Number of European countries with delegates attending the annual congress.
kpis.description: The 215 participants at the 2024 annual congress came from 11 different European countries, reflecting the organization's pan-European reach and its role as an international platform.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years. Indicator tracked annually, historical values over last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of €4.44B in the latest year
